title: P0: Secure IPC/File Access - path guard and shell:openExternal allowlist
description:
Implement project-root path guard for all fs:* IPC handlers in electron.js to prevent path traversal and arbitrary host-path access. Add protocol+hostname allowlist validation for shell:openExternal. Add tests.

Why: Without path guards, a compromised renderer (e.g. via XSS in .rpy content) can use fs:writeFile/removeEntry/etc to read/write/delete arbitrary files anywhere on the host. shell:openExternal with no URL validation can open file: or javascript: URLs.

Acceptance: Security tests pass; fs:* IPC no longer allows arbitrary host-path access; shell:openExternal only allows https:/http: protocols.

title: Extend theme system with Neon/Synthwave style dimensions
description: Extend the CSS variable theme system beyond color-only changes to include geometry (border-radius), glow/depth effects, typography, and spacing. Add a 'synthwave' theme preset that delivers Cyber-Minimalism / Neon-on-Midnight aesthetic with ambient glow, rounded cards, glassmorphism, and neon accent borders.
close_reason: Synthwave theme implemented with full style dimension system
